summary: PAPER-HANSEN-26 extracts Hansen, Excursion operators and the stable Bernstein center (Forum Math. Pi 14 (2026) e10). It has 29 items (0 library, 6 planned, 23 missing), three Part II routes and two source issues, after a careful review that checked every proof step. The planned stages hold, including SR.3 after its later RS-21 narrowing. Route 1's StableCenter Part II has since been joined consistently by FS21's Haines-conjecture item. Route 2's harmonic analysis has no other owner beyond ET.1, which the brief already imports. One finding, low. Route 3's title (copied from HKW22) uses the parent's pre-RS-22 title 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology'. RS-22 renamed the parent 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology' six days before the extraction. The same stale prefix is on all thirteen Part II routes to HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas across nine extractions, so the fix belongs with the maintainer as well as here.
checked: Independence: the extraction is by Claude Code cc-39fac3 (issue #1340, PR #4096) and its review by Claude Code cc-fb70e5 (#4463). This worker (Claude Code, cc-c2c06b) did neither, nor HKW22 or FS21.

Read all three routes and all 29 items in the repository at 7cd697e4, and the review's statement-by-statement checks. The seven planned stage ids exist in the assembled atlas (2840 stages, 8007 edges). Only SR.3 has been restructured, narrowed by RS-21 on 2026-09-29 after this review, and it still keeps 'the Bernstein block decomposition, identify the previously defined ordinary center with its block description and prove its action', so bernstein-center stays planned there. The review's note on Bernstein's distributional description stands.

Route 1 (ExcursionOperatorsAndSpectralActionStableCenter): its title reproduces the parent's current title. The id has since been joined by PAPER-FARGUES-SCHOLZE-21's route 11 (Haines' stable-center conjecture), added by that extraction's review on 2026-09-30 with the same id, title, parent and area, and with 'whose brief governs'. So the coalescence is consistent, and the review's statement that no other extraction proposes such a Part II was true when it was written.

Route 2 (SmoothRepresentationsCharactersPartII): the id and title match PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22 route 3, and the parent title is current. I searched the atlas for Kazhdan's density theorem, Harish-Chandra's local boundedness, the Weyl integration formula, the BDK constant term and Arthur's elliptic tempered characters. The only overlaps are ET.1 (orbital integrals, stable sums, matching test functions, real Paley–Wiener), which the brief already imports after the review, and Tau Ceti LieGroups Layer 6 (the compact-group Weyl integration formula, not the p-adic one). ET.6's 'character identity' is Scholze's GL_m construction, not Arthur's elliptic characters. So the nine items are rightly missing.

Route 3 (HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukasKottwitzPartII): the id and title match HKW22 route 1, but not the parent's title after RS-22 (finding 1). Its single item, the HKW character formula in inner-form generality, coalesces with HKW22's item for the same formula.

Duplication across extractions: searched every papers/*.result.json for very stable or stable Bernstein centers, atomic stability, stable characters and distributions, regular supercuspidal packets, Fargues–Scholze maps, excursion operators, Arthur's elliptic characters and stable orbital integrals. The FS21, Lafforgue, Feng, Böckle–Harris–Khare–Thorne, Ciubotaru–Harris, Gan–Harris–Sawin and Leslie hits concern the construction of excursion operators, global shtukas or orbital integrals, all planned at ES/LP/GS/ET stages. The only other stability item is FS21's Haines conjecture, which is coalesced as above.

Source issues: E1 (i_{i!} for i_{1!}) and the review's E2 (2ρ_G must be the sum of the positive roots of Ĝ, per Fu arXiv:2501.00652v1) are consistent with the item statements (fu-averaging uses the corrected ρ̂). I did not re-download the publisher PDF, whose per-download stamp makes hashes irreproducible, as the review's sourceVersions note records.

Library: nothing on Bernstein centers, orbital integrals, characters of p-adic groups, B(G) or excursion operators at Mathlib 082e2d3 or Tau Ceti f790474. This agrees with the extraction's zero library items and the review's search.

findings.claim: Route 3's title begins with the parent's old title: 'Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology, Part II: the Lefschetz–Verdier trace formula and the Kottwitz conjecture'. The accepted RS-22 retitled the parent 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology' on 2026-09-23, six days before this extraction. The atlas shows the new title. §16 asks a Part II to be titled '<that roadmap's title>, Part II: <what it adds>'. The review checked this for route 1 ('The title reproduces the parent's before the colon') but not for route 3, whose title was copied from PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22's route 1. HKW22 was extracted on 2026-09-23 at 00:25 UTC, before the retitle, so its title was right when written. The problem is wider than this paper. All thirteen part-ii routes to the three proposed Part IIs of HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas, across nine extractions, still carry a pre-RS-22 title. VANHOFTEN-24 even uses the older 'Hecke stacks and local shtukas'. Coalescing routes to the same id therefore agree with each other but not with the parent.
findings.evidence: Route 3 title, quoted above. research/blueprint/restructure/RS-22.result.json roadmaps['HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas']: {'action': 'keep', 'title': 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology', 'reason': 'Clarify which curve global in HS0 means …'}. REV-RS-22 committed 2026-09-23 12:26 UTC. The production assembly gives the roadmap title 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology'. The extraction was committed 2026-09-29 10:31 UTC (#4096) and REV-PAPER-HANSEN-26 on 2026-09-29 12:32 UTC (#4463). PROTOCOL.md §16: 'part-ii: it needs new layers in the direction of an existing roadmap. Propose "<that roadmap's title>, Part II: <what it adds>"'. Other routes with this parent: PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22 R1 (same id and title); PAPER-GLEASON-LIM-XU-26 R11 and R12, PAPER-KISIN-PAPPAS-ZHOU-26 R7, PAPER-SCHOLZE-WEINSTEIN-20 R4, PAPER-ZHU-17 R17, PAPER-HE-21 R10, PAPER-KISIN-17 R7 and PAPER-ZHU-17 R15 ('Hecke correspondences and local shtuka cohomology, Part II: …'); PAPER-VANHOFTEN-24 R7 and R9 ('Hecke stacks and local shtukas, Part II: …').
findings.fix: Retitle route 3 'Hecke correspondences on the Fargues–Fontaine curve and local shtuka cohomology, Part II: the Lefschetz–Verdier trace formula and the Kottwitz conjecture', and make the same change in PAPER-HANSEN-KALETHA-WEINSTEIN-22 route 1 so that the two coalescing routes keep one title. Tell the maintainer that every Part II of HeckeStacksAndLocalShtukas (the Kottwitz, Integral and AffineDeligneLusztig ids, thirteen routes in nine extractions) carries a pre-RS-22 parent title. The design jobs should take the parent's current title, or the queue generator should derive the prefix from it. Re-run check_paper.py.
